chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 289: Han Li Feigns Ignorance While Yuejing’s Rumors Swirl
chapter_meta_description: Han Li overhears a conspiracy of disappearing cultivators but chooses indifference. Two months of fake identity and estate politics test his survival instincts in Yuejing’s high society.
og_description: Han Li plays the fool while real tension builds in the capital. A dark conspiracy lurks behind recent cultivator disappearances.
twitter_title: Han Li the “Illegitimate Son” – RMJI Ch 289
twitter_description: Two months playing dumb in Yuejing. Han Li’s social game is stronger than most battles.

lore_anchors.definition: A non-combat high-stakes conflict where a cultivator must navigate conversation, reputation, and political hierarchy with the same cold calculation as a physical fight.
A cultivator's non-physical perception field; used here to surveil the entire Qin estate and eavesdrop on resentful whispers.
The stable cultivation stage after Qi Condensation, granting fixed lifespan extension and genuine magical abilities; Han Li is at this stage.
A higher cultivation stage; Han Li suspects a Core Formation cultivator may be behind the disappearances, which is enough to make him back off completely.
The genre philosophy of A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, where survival, resource hoarding, and cold calculation trump heroism, justice, or moral outrage.
